Synopsis:
If you saved Barcus from the windmill, you can meet him again in the underdark. He's been captured once again - this time by a band of duergar (who follow the Absolute, same as the goblins did previously). If you get rid of his captors, you can talk to him some more about his next steps. He's still keen on saving his friend, Wulbren.

Cluster Contexts:
- UND_UnfortunateGnome.json: The player has already rescued Barcus at the windmill and now finds him again in the Underdark after duergar captors (duergar here follow the Absolute, like the goblins did earlier) had taken him. If you free him, he explains he plans to head for Moonrise Towers to try to rescue the Ironhand gnomes — his friend Wulbren among them — and he’s outwardly resolute but plainly frightened. He claims he has no coin to reward you personally, though a foreman in the camp might provide pay. The exchange usually happens inside or just outside a duergar camp/checkpoint (tense, noisy, with guards, hauling rothé and enslaved gnomes), so off‑screen duergar leaders or other nearby NPCs and telepathic fragments may shape the terse, urgent tone.
- UND_GnomeForeman.json: You’ve just rescued a small Ironhand gnome party from duergar/cult captivity — the gnomes are shaken, reuniting with one another (Lunkbug and Beldron) and wary of the sergeant and their captors. Beldron, who’s taken on leadership after Wulbren’s disappearance, thanks the player but sizes you up warily at first because the gnomes had been enslaved by Absolutists/duergar. He explains their original mission: Wulbren led an expedition to Moonrise Towers to recover Gaerdal Ironhand’s legendary explosive, runepowder; Wulbren decoded the formula, burned the book when the cult attacked, and may now carry the only copy in his head. The cult could torture him for that knowledge — a threat that could level the Sword Coast — but Beldron is exhausted and pragmatic, bound by his people’s needs and obligations back in the city.
- FOR_GnomeGoblin1_Surrender_NotAtWindmill.json: After being defeated in combat, a goblin named Fezzerk begs for mercy from the player. He tries to bargain for his life. The player can let him go or kill him. This dialogue takes place somewhere away from the windmill where Fezzerk was tormenting Barcus Wroot.
- WYR_UnfortunateGnome.json: Barcus dialog in gnomes hideout cellar in WYR Rivington (he's in act1 and act2). Gives player a quest to investigate Gondian workshop.
- SCE_Wulbren.json: This dialogue is peak Wulbren. If he's met you in haven (after you saved him), he rolls back on how rude he was as he realises the player would be an amazing asset in the city. If this is your first time meeting him since the escape (if haven is destroyed he waits out on the river until this scene in the epilogue), he realises how good the player would be to have on his side in the city and tells him all about how wronged the ironhand gnomes were.

context: You previously rescued the gnome Barcus at the windmill; here you find him again in the Underdark after he’d been captured by duergar loyal to the Absolute. The scene is a tense duergar camp or checkpoint — noisy, watched by guards, with rothé and enslaved gnomes nearby — so the exchange is urgent and fraught. If you free him, Barcus says he has no coin to reward you personally but the camp foreman might offer pay, and he insists on heading for Moonrise Towers to try to rescue the Ironhand gnomes, including his friend Wulbren. Other rescued gnomes later explain that Wulbren’s party had been seeking Gaerdal Ironhand’s runepowder and that Wulbren may carry crucial knowledge in his head, making his capture especially dangerous.
